thread:
olivia_csm: Notifying team — we have an authentication regression impacting new VPC/onboard tenants created in the past 48h. Customers see failures during token refresh; hitting this in trial flows. Drafting comms and asking for credit approval + enablement offers. Incident INC-2025-872. @jamal_support @steve_eng please confirm root cause and ETA for fix.
jamal_support: Repro and root cause: a bounds check in the refresh handler rejects refreshes when refresh_window is exactly 0. Logs: `auth.refresh tenant=tn-859 status=401 window=0`. Repro steps: create tenant -> trigger refresh -> see 401 at /v1/auth/refresh.
steve_eng: Confirmed. Hotfix: revert the offending check, add a unit test and integration test for the boundary case. Plan: canary deploy in us-west-2 at 08:40 UTC; monitor for 15m, then full rollout target 09:15 UTC. I will update statuspage once canary looks green.
incident-bot: INC-2025-872 | created | sev: high | impacted: ~37 new trial tenants (VPC onboarding) | status: investigating
liam_csm: Query results: 9 of the impacted tenants have trial expiration <30 days; 4 of those are marked high-touch (renewal at-risk). We should treat those 4 with prioritized outreach and a stronger mitigation offer.
olivia_csm: Draft short customer note for trials: "Hi — we're investigating an authentication problem affecting onboarding for a subset of new VPC tenants created in the last 48 hours. Our engineers are rolling a fix and we expect service to be restored within ~60 minutes. For affected trials we'll apply a one-week platform credit and offer a 1:1 enablement session to help complete setup. We apologize for the inconvenience. — Olivia, Redwood CSM"
jamal_support: Add a quick workaround to share: either re-run the onboarding job with a short retry delay or rotate the onboarding token in Console. Sanitized curl to retry:```\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/onboard/retry \\\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \\\n  -d '{"tenant_id":"tn-859"}'\n```
steve_eng: Ops alternative: we can flip an internal per-tenant flag that relaxes refresh enforcement while the fix rolls. That avoids manual retries for customers. @sam_ops can flip this for the cohort. If Ops enables it, we can send the blast immediately and avoid many support tickets.
sam_ops: Enabling the relax-refresh flag now for the impacted cohort. I'll watch auth error rate and success count for 30m and post metrics. If you want the 9 near-expiry tenants prioritized, paste IDs here and I'll bump them to top of the queue.
olivia_csm: Pasting the 9 tenant IDs to you in DM. I'm preparing two comm variants: short trial note (above) and an executive-level note for renewal-risk accounts. Exec draft below: "Hello — we are reaching out proactively. During onboarding some trial VPC tenants experienced intermittent authentication failures; engineers are deploying a fix now and we expect full availability shortly. To reduce disruption we will (1) apply a one-week usage credit, (2) schedule a 1:1 enablement session within 3 business days, and (3) assign a CS lead for priority coordination. We will follow up with an RCA and a short impact survey. Please reply with preferred times for a 30-min call. — Olivia"
liam_csm: Looks good. For the exec note, add a line about next steps for renewal discussions and include the survey link so we can capture business impact. I will take point on the 4 high-touch accounts after the initial message goes out.
maria_finance: Quick finance ack needed: one-week credit for affected trials is within our standard goodwill limits. I approve credits for this incident cohort. Please tag invoices affected for tracking.
olivia_csm: Thanks Maria. CS leads please confirm copy and timing so I can send once Sam confirms the flag flip and Steve confirms canary health. Also planning a follow-up with a concise technical RCA one-liner: "Cause: an off-by-one bounds check in the refresh handling logic caused valid refreshes to be rejected." Keep the follow-up non-technical for customers and include the RCA link for those who want details.
jamal_support: +1. After rollback we'll include a short ticket-friendly note for support responses and a template for customers who need immediate assistance.
steve_eng: I'll publish an ops postmortem and link to it in the follow-up. Targeting a public status update at ~09:30 UTC after full rollout verification.
olivia_csm: Final plan: wait for Sam confirmation of flag flip and for Steve to confirm canary healthy; then send trial blast and exec notes for the prioritized list. I'll schedule 1:1 enablement sessions for responders. Thanks team — will post when messages go out.
